desc: Remove a view from a code channel.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing the `code_channels:manage` scope. Must be a granular bot token.

channel_id.desc: ID of the code channel to remove the view from.

view_key.desc: Agent-assigned key of the view to remove. Provide exactly one of view_key or view_id.

view_id.desc: Encoded channel tab ID of the view to remove. Provide exactly one of view_key or view_id.

channel_id.desc: The encoded ID of the code channel the view was removed from.

view_id.desc: The encoded channel tab ID of the removed view.

channel_not_found.desc: The specified channel does not correspond to a valid channel.

not_agent_channel.desc: The specified channel is not a code channel.

not_authorized.desc: The caller is not an authorized agent bot or member for this channel.

view_not_found.desc: No agent view matches the supplied view_key or view_id in this channel.

not_view_owner.desc: The view was created by a different agent bot; only its owner may remove it.

invalid_arguments.desc: Exactly one of view_key or view_id must be provided.

view_remove_failed.desc: The view's tab or channel properties could not be updated. Safe to retry.
